[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Emergency triage on /mnt/hercules[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]triage[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]triage: reclaim immediate headroom on the 100%-full RAID array by [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]clearing interrupted-rotation leftovers and the oldest redundant backup [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rotations, without touching Plex media.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Ephemeral cache reclamation on /[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rootreclaim[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rootreclaim: purge regenerable caches and stale temp data on the root [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]filesystem - Docker, APT archives, journald, /var/tmp, the uv cache, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]disabled snap revisions, and root's own caches.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Plex video preview thumbnails[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]plexthumbs[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plexthumbs: remove the 73.8G of .bif preview thumbnails under [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]/var/lib/plexmediaserver and turn off the generation setting that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recreates them.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust and agent-workspace build artifacts[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]buildart[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]buildart: prune the 125G sase-core target directory and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-workspace Rust target copies under ~/.local/state/sase/workspaces, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]then redirect future builds to a single shared, size-capped location.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Backup exclusion list for regenerable data[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]bkexclude: extend the rsync exclude list in backup.sh so build [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifacts, agent workspaces, and toolchain caches stop being copied into[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every backup rotation.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hardlinked backup rotations via --link-dest[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bklinkdest[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bkexclude[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bklinkdest: make each rotation an incremental hardlink snapshot instead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of a full independent copy, which is the single largest structural win [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the array.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Monitoring, alerting, and regression guards[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]guardrails: add Prometheus disk alerts, recurring cleanup jobs, and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]documented steady-state baseline so neither filesystem silently refills.[/#D7D7AF]
